name: Staff of the Magi: Protection from Evil and Good

system.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.

definition.label: Staff of the Magi: Protection from Evil and Good

notes: uses: a partial recovery refills the whole pool
not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
concentration: nothing it sustains was converted
